_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for fleet projects: tier + repo + deploy reality. Replaces the scattered split between agent-surfaces-registry.json (web GEO surfaces only), cloudflare.targets.json (partial deploy map), and project-tiers.md (focus marking). Reconciled against the live Cloudflare account 2026-07-18.

fields.family: top-level product family this belongs to
fields.tier: focus | active | secondary | parked | out-of-fleet | non-product
fields.portfolio: owner-facing classification with kind (product | platform | experiment), priority (P1 | P2 | P4), status (active | archived), deployed boolean, readyToBeShared boolean, and sharingReadiness evidence with verifiedAt and reason
fields.repo: child repo dir under fleet root (null if none)
fields.sourcePath: optional source checkout path relative to fleet root when the repo is stored outside the active workspace
fields._meta.absorbedCheckouts: top-level historical checkout names preserved locally and their canonical catalog identities
fields.cfProject: Cloudflare Pages project name and/or Worker script name(s)
fields.cfPages: optional exact Cloudflare Pages project names when cfProject also describes Worker surfaces
fields.deployTargets: optional exact per-surface objects with id, kind, name, and sourcePath; required for mixed or multi-source deploys
fields.d1Databases: optional exact Cloudflare D1 database names currently owned by this project
fields.tursoDatabases: optional exact Turso database names owned by this project
fields.databaseResources: optional exact relational database resources with provider, name, and prepared | authoritative | rollback-held state
fields.infrastructure: complete per-project deployment and provider-resource inventory; every project id must have one entry, including inactive and local-only projects
fields.domains: live custom domains (empty = pages.dev only or undeployed)
fields.domainProbePaths: optional per-domain HTTP path overrides for live health probes
fields.name: human display name
fields.repositoryUrl: owner-visible canonical source repository; may be private and is not emitted by the public projection
fields.metrics: optional per-project metric eligibility overrides; publicSite true includes a maintained product in all outcome views, while domainCoverage true includes only its live domain in domain-strength coverage
fields.public: sanitized public listing metadata; listing is maintained | past | hidden
fields.readyToBeShared: true only for the exact maintained public surface and evidenced claims that were approved; native, store, download, or binary availability must be tracked separately and never inferred
fields.geoIdentities: canonical public identity and applicability contract for every maintained visibility product
